newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's CPP rate for August falls to 27.52 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's CPP rate for August falls to 27.52 pct.

text.p: Mexico's CPP interest rate, which measures the average cost of capturing funds in pesos for Mexico's banks, fell 166 basis points to 27.52 percent for August from 29.18 percent for July, Banco de Mexico said Monday.
The related CCP bank rate, which is to gradually replace the CPP rate and is considered more accurate by financial authorities, fell to 28.58 percent for August from 30.01 percent for July.

The CCP-UDI rate, which measures a real rate for lending denominated in the government's inflation-linked UDIs, or investment units, fell to 7.98 percent for August from 8.11 percent in July, the central bank said.
